DIAGNOSIS READY: Azathioprine-induced cholestatic hepatitis.

The clinical picture of fatigue and severe pruritus, combined with a cholestatic liver enzyme pattern (markedly elevated ALP) while on azathioprine for ulcerative colitis, strongly supports drug-induced liver injury. We have ruled out acute viral hepatitis in the immediate context, and the timing correlates with chronic immunosuppressive therapy. I will monitor your bilirubin levels and consider adjusting or discontinuing the medication, but this appears to be the primary diagnosis based on current data.
